data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 322.1m. Using the gross claims development table, there is a small net adverse prior-year development of GBP 1.91m (c.0.6% of opening reserves) driven by increases on the 2015-2016 underwriting years partially offset by releases on earlier years. The 2018 underwriting year was impacted by a series of large natural catastrophe and man-made losses (including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Californian wildfires and the Lurssen shipyard fire); the Syndicate reports that the net impact was managed due to the effectiveness of its reinsurance and retrocessional programme.
raw_causal_phrases: The performance for 2018 was impacted by a series of catastrophic events in the second half of the year.
Hurricanes Florence and Michael together with the Californian wildfires cost the industry an estimated $80 billion making 2018 the fourth costliest year on record
Catastrophic events were not limited to the US. We also saw the impact of Typhoon Trami, Jebi and Mangkhut.
The Syndicate also experienced a number of large losses in the year including the Lurssen shipyard fire, Onshore energy losses in the final quarter and Power outage losses.
The impact of catastrophe losses on Syndicate 1910 net of reinsurance recoveries added 13.2% (2017:18.2%) percentage points to the combined ratio.
In 2018, there has been an overall (deterioration)/improvement of GBP 11.6m (2017: GBP 38.5m).
The provision for claims outstanding comprises amounts set aside for claims notified and claims incurred but not yet reported (IBNR).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (diagonal comparison) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision' GROSS figure was provided. The report contains a narrative net figure (GBP 11.6m) which appears to be net of reinsurance and therefore was not used for the GROSS PYD. Triangle contains minor OCR/formatting artifacts (e.g. '80.01' read from table); values rounded. Reinsurance to close and quota-share arrangements exist in the Syndicate and can distort comparisons; users should treat the PYD derived from the triangle as an approximation (confidence 0.8).
